content.short: X2Y2 is a decentralized NFT marketplace for buying and selling NFTs, bulk listing, batch purchases, real-time notifications, and viewing rarities, with APIs.
content.description: Launched on January 28, 2022, X2Y2 is a decentralized NFT marketplace that lets users buy and sell NFTs, bulk list items, and perform batch purchases. It provides real-time notifications and NFT rarity insights. Developers can use X2Y2's Open APIs and JavaScript SDK to build web3 applications such as analytics tools and trading bots. The platform does not offer private token sales, and all market fees are distributed to X2Y2 stakers.
